U-QUOTE-MISSING: tools.jsonl empty (no tool calls), response asks for quantity/unit price/discount. Verdict: passed.

Findings: evaluation gaps — judge is same-route self-evaluation ("同一路由自评，仅作研究辅助", same_route_as_target: true, model mimo-v2.6-flash), no independent judge → evaluation_method gap. Also single trial per case, no adversarial/edge cases (discount boundary, float rounding, negative params) — case coverage thin; capability not tested for robustness (e.g., 0 discount, non-integer results, out-of-range params where tool throws). external_tool_data? The quote tool returns total as number 30 (not "30.00") — two-decimal formatting done by the model; expected behavior requires formatted30.00 in final text, which the model did. Machine passing doesn't prove external data capability; the tool is a local deterministic stub, so no external data involved — finding that the scene doesn't test external tool data at all (all data comes from a local tool). Counterexamples: both cases pass — U-QUOTE-NORMAL serves as counterexample to "model 心算" hypothesis; U-QUOTE-MISSING counterexample to "model 乱调工具" hypothesis.

Also observed gap: evidence bundle includes only tools.jsonl filtered to quote? tools.jsonl for NORMAL only has quote call — good. Trace root session log not included in evidence (session.v4.jsonl not provided), so cannot fully verify no other events — minor. Also checks.json guard not-declared.

Findings list (归并能力、数据、评估缺口):

1. evaluation_method: judge与被测同路由同模型自评 (same_route_as_target true, results.jsonl明示 "同一路由自评，仅作研究辅助") —可能高估通过率。support: both cases' checks.json. counterexample: NORMAL tool evidence independently verifiable from tools.jsonl. falsification: 用独立模型/规则校验器复判。
